## Objective

Establish checked delivery to the registered Template while preserving active project installations.

## Scope

- Verify the mapped Template update
- Verify the Template package and adoption boundaries

## Entry conditions

- The final source candidate and required host cases pass.

## Exit criteria

- The update engine reports current after the authorized mapping is inspected.
- Template-copy tests pass and mapped files match the final candidate.
- Active-root, ordinary products, registry and unrelated artifacts retain their authorized state.

## Risks

- The existing watcher may already have propagated files; inspect current results and never infer root adoption.
- Unrelated pending mappings, customized files or recovery work block a broad apply.

## TASK-020 - Verify the mapped Template update

Inspect the existing update pipeline and let its authorized mapping bring only the to-trd candidate into the registered Template, applying a reviewed update only if the current check requires it.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |

| Requirements | REQ-019, REQ-020 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | Verification/to-trd-intent-discovery/template-update.md, Projects/Sys4AI-Template-Project/.agents/skills/to-trd/ |
| Dependencies | None |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- A global apply may include unrelated pending source changes, and a customized Template file must not be overwritten.

### Acceptance criteria

- The recorded check identifies the exact pending destination set and any automatic watcher result; unrelated changes or conflicts stop the bounded apply.
- The final Template check reports current for the reviewed mapping, with candidate files matching their mapped destinations.
- No active-root or ordinary product refresh, direct Template edit, registry edit, watcher installation or service-control action occurs.

### Planned verification

- Run .venv/bin/python tools/template_update.py check and inspect its complete structured result.
- If only the authorized mapping needs publication, run .venv/bin/python tools/template_update.py apply and inspect its receipt; if already current, retain the no-write result.
- Run check again after any apply and compare every source-package file with its mapped Template counterpart; preserve and report any conflict or recovery state.

### Risks

- Passing source tests must not be reported as a tested Template copy or active-root adoption.

### Acceptance criteria

- The Template-copy helper tests pass using its own test path, and its package links, metadata, examples and protected provenance remain consistent.
- The source and mapped Template inventories match the candidate manifest; the active-root copy retains its baseline bytes and is reported separately.
- Project TRDs, existing Task and unmanaged-plan artifacts, root governance and registry retain the authorized state, with any independently authorized ledger operation distinguished.

### Planned verification

- Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s Projects/Sys4AI-Template-Project/.agents/skills/to-trd/tests -v.
- Compare source, Template and active-root file inventories and inspect actual destination guidance.
- Run read-only TRD validation and compare protected artifact hashes without repairing their indexes or changing lifecycle states.
